Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner swapped the directors’ birth dates during synthesis—assigning 1929-12-21 to Jean Yarbrough and 1900-08-22 to Takhir Sabirov—despite prior WebSurfer results showing the opposite (Yarbrough: 1900-08-22; Sabirov: 1929-12-21). This misattribution led to the incorrect conclusion that The Last Night of Scheherazade’s director was born first.
